items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: that's how I got in Zack Whyte's band.

ctx.x: And he played with Zack Whyte before I joined the band. He played with Zack Whyte in '29. He played baritone, you know. He used to stomp his foot way high to get that rhythm, you know. He left there and went to Buffalo, like a lot of musicians.
Did you know Buffalo was a center for a lot of musicians back in the thirties?
